scope: Counterfactual token-row counts on the released-Router NONE diagnostic; includes native dummy rows. No measured FLOPs, wasted compute, graph time, or throughput prediction. One global vector per internal batch from rank0, install/stop edges included. Other ranks are not added again.

source_verification.padding_rule: A synchronized graph mode other than NONE pads every rank to the largest rank token count. A count above max_cudagraph_capture_size selects NONE.

calculation: Flatten records[*].rows from the rank0 dispatch file. Each row contributes its single tokens_across_dp vector. Sum the vector for native rows. For a hypothetical graph grid, multiply the smallest grid size >= max(vector) by 16. For a max-32 grid, keep the native sum when max(vector)>32. Do not add the other 15 copies of each global vector.
decision: Only 220/3768 observed global batches (5.84%) fit a max-32 graph. A max-32-only full-hour trial is low priority on this observed recipe; a changed routing recipe needs its own shape evidence. The 2K graph grid would count about 3.42 times the native rows, but this is not a time or speedup estimate.
